title: Red Rising
author: Pierce Brown
summary: A young miner on Mars believes his labour is building a future for humanity, then learns that his caste is being lied to. He is surgically remade as one of the ruling elite and sent to infiltrate their brutal training school.
readIf: you like violent, high-stakes stories of rebellion and want a hero who has to become what he hates.
skipIf: you are sensitive to graphic violence, because the school section is relentlessly brutal.

pairings.reason: A cleaner, shorter story of an oppressed young person forced into a deadly arena.
Also about a gifted young recruit and a school that trains leaders with harsh methods.
An even bleaker military school story, in a fantasy world, where the cost of power keeps rising.
